# Intercom (`eyevinn-intercom-manager`)

Open Source Intercom Solution providing production-grade audio quality and real-time latency. Powered by Symphony Media Bridge open source media server.

Join our Slack community for support and customization. Contact sales@eyevinn.se for further development and support. Visit Eyevinn Technology for innovative video solutions.

[Service documentation](https://docs.osaas.io/osaas.wiki/Service%3A-Intercom.html) · [Source](https://github.com/Eyevinn/intercom-manager)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "eyevinn-intercom-manager"
  name       = "mymanager"

  parameters = {
    smbUrl     = "..."
    # iceServers = "..."
  }

  sensitive_parameters = {
    smbApiKey = var.smb_api_key
    dbUrl = var.db_url
    oscAccessToken = var.osc_access_token
    whipAuthKey = var.whip_auth_key
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `smbUrl` | string | yes | URL to the Symphony Media Bridge Pattern `^http`. |
| `smbApiKey` | string | yes | API key for the Symphony Media Bridge Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `dbUrl` | string | yes | URL including credentials to couchdb. Database expected as path Pattern `^http`. Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `oscAccessToken` | string | no | Personal Access Token from Eyevinn Open Source Cloud for link sharing and reauthentication features Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `whipAuthKey` | string | no | Authentication key for WHIP (WebRTC-HTTP Ingestion Protocol) endpoints Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `iceServers` | string | no | Comma-separated list of ICE servers for WebRTC connectivity, including STUN and TURN servers |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
